title: Help now
intro: You are not alone. If you or your child are in danger right now, call one of these numbers.
lifeThreat: If there is a threat to life — call 112
noPhones: Phone numbers appear after the app has connected once. In an emergency, call 112.

contact.heading: Talk to a person
contact.description: A psychologist on duty will contact you as soon as possible.

status.sent: Request sent. A person on duty will contact you.
status.queued: No connection. Your request is saved and will be sent automatically when you are back online.
status.signedOut: Sending a request to a moderator needs sign-in. The phones and 112 work without it.
status.failed: The request could not be sent. Please call one of the numbers above.
